model_interpretation.claim: Interleaving four independent scalar pixel states may expose instruction-level parallelism and reduce recurrence dependency stalls. The per-lane escape checks and recurrence order remain unchanged; lanes with different escape lengths and the scalar tail may reduce or eliminate any benefit.
model_interpretation.transformations: {"files":["src/candidate.cpp"],"retained":["Process complete groups of four adjacent pixels with named scalar state variables interleaved across iterations.","Track each lane's active state independently so each pixel retains its own escape count despite differing escape lengths.","Use the original scalar Mandelbrot routine for the non-divisible row tail and retain complete output overwrite behavior."]}

model_interpretation.claim: Dynamic scheduling of one complete row at a time may reduce imbalance from rows with different Mandelbrot iteration counts compared with contiguous static row allocation. The serial branch avoids OpenMP overhead when the usable team is one; capping the team by height avoids requesting workers that cannot receive rows. The recurrence and per-pixel coordinate expressions remain unchanged.

items.subject: Mesurer l’intégration du kernel scalaire intercalé avec OpenMP
items.objective: En partant de la source la plus rapide, e2bb341cd8234f50, intégrer la distribution OpenMP par lignes de 0933e856de4d4829 au kernel d’interleaving scalaire par quatre. Respecter le budget `threads`, conserver une voie sérielle, et préserver les calculs flottants et l’écriture complète. Mesurer le programme combiné à un et quatre cœurs et vérifier les petites tailles et bornes décalées; ne pas supposer que les gains s’additionnent.
